What are the most expensive comic books ever sold?
By 2004, the most expensive comic book was sold for $350,000.
Below is a list of some of the most expensive comics ever sold, as of this writing.
Action Comics #1 is invariably at or very near the top of the list of most expensive comic books.

results.title: Rare Superman comic breaks record and becomes most expensive ever sold at auction | Euronews
results.content: A rare first edition of Superman, discovered by three brothers in their late mother's attic, has fetched a record-shattering $9.12m (€7.9m) at auction in Texas, US, making it the most expensive comic book ever sold.
